actual_scope: Independently audit the unchanged PR2540 borrowed-current-field write projection and prove the sharp all-horizon restoration-error bound under PR2628 completed relative native defects.
scope_change_reason: Revision 5 advances QQ16 to complete caller obligations. PR2628 explicitly leaves controller composition open; this isolates repeated retained-observation use rather than duplicating its single-invocation error envelopes.
bottleneck_link: A QQ16 caller cannot infer reusable exact observations or an unbounded precision horizon from the local added decoder. The result quantifies this specific restoration obligation without admitting a supplier.
stop_rule: Stop after the borrowed-write projection, sharp all-N bound, admissible bias witness and source/semantic controls. Do not expand into a physical child, consumer, global cost optimization or supplier.
